data.title: Generic home improvement company setup
data.description: The foundation for a full home improvement company setup: account creation, generic workspace branding, services, and the kinds of work the company performs. Additional setup pages will follow.

stages.notes: Standard identity and company creation; skipped by sandbox instances.
Use the shared production branding flow with a lightweight generic workspace preview: branded left rail, general interface styling, and a sample modal.
Select common services or search a broader home improvement catalog.
Select any combination of replacement, repair, and ongoing maintenance work.
